player.subtitle: In this section you can configure the ability to watch releases using torrents, as well as other playback settings
player.torrentsDescription1: You can connect torrents that will automatically be linked to release episodes and available for viewing.
player.torrentsDescription2: Torrents do not require a third-party player or client and are available online, in the release playback quality selection menu.
player.torrentsWarning: Using torrents requires more connection and parsing time, which can negatively affect the speed of loading data for releases, especially when using a proxy server
player.autoplayNextEpisodeDescription: After the episode ends, the player will automatically start playing the next episode in the release, if available
player.videoBufferDescription: Video preload buffer size, default 5 minutes
player.videoBufferHint: Specifies the amount of buffer that the player keeps in memory and preloads video during viewing
player.autoSkipOpeningDescription: If there are opening skip marks, it will be skipped automatically
player.autoSkipHotKey: Hotkey for enabling and disabling auto-skip
player.skipOpeningButtonDescription1: An additional button will appear in the player interface that will rewind the player by the specified number of seconds
player.skipOpeningButtonDescription2: This button does not guarantee correct opening skipping
player.skipOpeningButtonHotKey: Hotkey for the opening skip button
player.skipOpeningTimeDescription: You can specify how many seconds to skip the opening
player.skipOpeningTimeLabel: Number of seconds to skip the opening

system.title: Application settings
system.subtitle: In this section you can configure automatic release updates, system notifications and other application parameters
system.moveControlsRight: Move control buttons to the right
system.moveControlsRightDescription: Moves window control buttons (minimize, close and expand) to the right
system.filterNotificationsByFavoritesDescriptio: Enables showing notifications only for releases from favorites
system.proxyDescription1: Proxy for connecting to the static server and API. HTTP and HTTPS are supported
system.proxyDescription2: After changing the access point, it is recommended to restart the application
system.endpointDescription1: You can use the main domain if it is not blocked by your provider, or use additional domains
system.endpointDescription2: You can enter your API and static server connection point in the "API connection point" and "Static server connection point" fields
system.discordRichPresenceDescription: The application will display information about the release being viewed in Discord Rich Presence
system.showSystemNotificationsDescription: If the application detects an updated release when loading the latest releases, it will show a system notification about a new episode
system.autoUpdateReleasesDescription: The application will update the latest releases in the background, even if it is minimized
system.updateIntervalDescription: You can specify how often the application will update releases in the background
system.showAdsBeforeEpisodeDescription: If this option is disabled, ads will not be shown before each episode
